source: OIML R 76-1:2006 - Table 3 (classification), Table 6 (maximum permissible errors on initial verification), 3.5.2, 3.5.3, 3.6, 3.9.2, 3.9.3, 4.5, 4.6, A.4.4
notes: All metrological limits below are transcribed from OIML R 76-1:2006.
The schema is data, not code: when OIML or the Legal Metrology (General) Rules are
revised, an administrator edits this file (or uploads a new version in the admin UI)
and no engine code changes are required. Each generated report records the revision
used, so historical reports remain traceable to the rule set that produced them.

I.title: Special accuracy
I.notes: e >= 0.001 g. n may be less than 50 000 for d < 0.1 mg.

minCapacityOverride.appliesTo: Instruments that determine a transport tariff or toll (e.g. postal scales, waste weighing)

errorDetermination.errorBeforeCorrection: E = P - L = I + 0.5e - dL - L

zeroSetting.trackingNote: Deviation limit aligned with the 0.5 e stability limit used in 3.9.4; confirm against the licensed copy of R 76-1 used by the laboratory.

tare.mpeRule: Same MPE as the instrument for the same value of load (3.5.3.4)

temperature.criterion: Error at every test temperature shall not exceed the MPE for the applied load

powerSupply.criterion: Error at every voltage shall not exceed the MPE for the applied load

creep.criterion: Deviation of indication over the observation period <= 0.5 e

discrimination.criterion: An additional load of 1.4 d gently applied shall produce a change of indication of at least one scale interval

testModules.title: Weighing performance test
testModules.description: Errors determined at increasing and decreasing loads, including Min and Max, with change-over sub-weights of 1/10 e.

testModules.title: Eccentricity (corner load) test
testModules.description: Test load of 1/3 of Max applied at the specified positions; each indication shall meet the MPE.

testModules.title: Repeatability test
testModules.description: Repeated weighings of the same load; the difference between results shall not exceed the absolute MPE for that load.

testModules.title: Zero-setting and zero-tracking test
testModules.description: Initial zero-setting range, accuracy after zero setting and automatic zero-tracking deviation.

testModules.title: Tare device test
testModules.description: Accuracy of the tare device and MPE applied to net values for every tare load.

testModules.title: Temperature influence test
testModules.description: Static temperatures across the specified range; errors shall not exceed the MPE for the applied load.

testModules.title: Power supply (voltage) influence test
testModules.description: Mains voltage between 0.85 and 1.10 of nominal; errors shall not exceed the MPE for the applied load.

testModules.title: Creep and return to zero test
testModules.description: Deviation of the indication while a load remains on the instrument, and deviation on returning to zero.
